If in urgent use, only need to charge it in 90 seconds, then can open 2 bottles of wine.

Safe, no dangers of an exposed corkscrew - with finger protection design, it can prevent you and children from hurting by the sharp corkscrew. The corkscrew is placed in the inner structure of the device, and will not protrude out the bottom of the wine opener during operation.
